title: Omoi Announces Digital Release of Shō Asahina's Tsuyo-Girl Manga in January
content:
Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Thursday the exclusive digital release of Shō Asahina 's Tsuyo-Girl manga on its website and app in January. Omoi will release the manga with the English title Tsuyo-Girl: Taking Charge .

Omoi describes the manga's story:

Straight black hair with a blonde streak, chunky earrings, and striking red lipstick — Yuki starts college with a strong sense of style that makes heads turn. But a week passes, and she hasn't made a single friend. All of her classmates are too intimidated to even approach her! Just when she begins to lose hope, Yuki discovers that her favorite fashion influencer attends her school and reconnects with an old classmate who still has feelings for her. Could these chance encounters be the beginning of the friendships and connections Yuki has been searching for? From Shō Asahina , creator of It's Not Easy Being Cute , and originally published in the magazine Comic Elmo ( The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting , Natsume & Natsume ), Tsuyo-Girl: Taking Charge is a bold and fashion-forward romantic comedy about self-expression and confidence, with an earnest main character you just can't help but root for.

Asahina launched the manga on Micro Magazine 's Comic Elmo manga website in April 2021. Micro Magazine published the manga's first compiled book volume in October 2021, and the manga ended with its fifth volume in December 2022.

Asahina's It's Not Easy Being Cute ( "Kawaii" wa, Tokidoki Kurushii. ) manga launched on X (formerly Twitter ) in September 2024. It began serialization on Gangan pixiv in September 2025. The manga recently ended with its third volume on October 22. Both Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service and Comikey publish the manga in English digitally.
author: ANN

title: This World is Worth Fighting For Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content:
Hatsumi Kodama 's This World is Worth Fighting For ( Kono Yo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru ) manga is getting a live-action series on Fuji TV in January 2027.

Hiyori Sakurada stars as Ito Kiri.

Kaede Kamiya is directing the series. Yasuko Kuramitsu is writing the screenplay.

Ito Kiri has had enough. She's 25, is in her third year at a company she hates where she's also getting sexually harassed, and dating a shitty guy. She exists solely on energy drinks and one thought: “I want to be useful to others.” But she's beginning to reach her limit and feeling hopeless about her future. That is, until she receives a mysterious letter one day. No return address, no name, just a message she needed: Permission to live freely and on her terms. From that moment, something changes in her and she decides she's doing whatever it takes to live a life worth living. And she's not holding back or pulling any punches.

Kodama debuted the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2023, and ended it in October 2025. The fifth and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan on January 30.

title: hololive Shop Reports Customer Information Leak
content:
OPENLOGI had announced that its systems were subject to unauthorized access between November 8-9. The hololive shop outsourced shipping operations to OPENLOGI until June 2025, but it has since stopped using its services. However, some of the shipping data taken externally were from when hololive shop used OPENLOGI's services.

The information leaked includes names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, order numbers, purchase amounts, and tracking numbers for about 300 shipping records for orders placed on hololive shop between September 1, 2022-November 25, 2024. Credit card information is not included in the leak.

The hololive shop has begun contacting individual customers via email on Tuesday. The company reported this incident to the Personal Information Protection Commission of Japan. It also requested OPENLOGI to provide a report of the incident and handle remaining customer information belonging to hololive shop appropriately.

The first generation of hololive performers debuted in 2018. There are over 80 virtual YouTubers who currently belong to hololive. The talents perform using intricate 2D and 3D avatars provided by the company. COVER Corporation launched hololive Indonesia — a spinoff group aimed toward the Indonesian audience — in April 2020, followed by hololive English in September 2020. The all-male holostars spinoff group debuted its first generation talent in June 2019. According to hololive production 's English website , it has over 90 million subscribers across all its channels.

In related news, online retailer CDJapan reported on Wednesday that customers' personal information was exposed to third parties as a result of unauthorized access.
author: ANN

title: Getbackers Manga Gets Comic Anime From AI Platform MangaNow Studio
content:
A new official X/Twitter account for Yuya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's GetBackers manga announced on Wednesday that the series is getting a comic anime on YouTube on December 1.

AI platform MangaNow Studio is directing, producing, and editing the comic anime.

The new voice actors for the main duo are Tarо̄ Shumi as Ban Mido and Takayuki Itо̄ as Ginji Amano.

The show follows the adventures of Ban and Ginji, two young men who hire themselves out to "get back" things that people have lost.

Aoki and Ayamine debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 1999, and ended it in February 2007. The manga had 39 compiled book volumes. Tokyopop once published the manga before losing the rights in 2009.

The manga inspired a 49-episode anime series that premiered in 2002, with an American release by ADV Films following in 2004.

title: Manga 'Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou' Concludes with 14th Volume
content:
Aoi Akashiro and Sonshou Hangetsuban 's Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou ( Working for God in a Godless World ) manga ended its serialization on October 2. The 77th and final chapter marked the end of its seven-year run. The 14th and final volume is scheduled to be released on November 30.

Akashiro began writing the fantasy manga illustrated by Hangetsuban in Monthly Hero's magazine in May 2019. Following the magazine's discontinuation in October 2020, the series moved to the Comiplex website under the Wild Hero's label in November of that year. Kadokawa published the 13th volume on June 29.

A spin-off manga, titled Kaminaki Sekai no Oneechan Katsudou , began serialization on the Comiplex website in November 2022. The first volume was released in March 2023.

Titan Comics licensed the manga in English in February 2024 and released the fifth volume on April 14.

A 12-episode television anime adaptation produced by Studio Palette in Spring 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series with subtitles in multiple languages and dubs.

title: 'Gensou Suikoden' Reveals Additional Cast
content:
The official website of Gensou Suikoden ( Suikoden: The Anime ) revealed additional cast on Wednesday. The anime series adapting Konami's fantasy role-playing game premiered on October 3 at 11.30 p.m. on Tokyo MX followed by Kansai TV, BS Asahi, and 32 other stations.

Cast Makai: Ikuji Nose ( Mob Psycho 100 ) Tai Ho: Masaki Ishimine Yam Koo: Hideyuki Kobayashi ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e 4th Season: 2-nensei-hen 1 Gakki ) Ridley: Takaya Kuroda ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) Gabocha: Makoto Koichi ( Medalist ) Sid: Wataru Komada ( Blue Lock ) Chaco: Kouhei Amasaki ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Susu: Eiko Hanawa ( Odd Taxi ) Fitcher: Satoshi Tsuruoka ( Mushoku Tensei )

Yuuzou Satou ( Exception ) is helming the anime at Konami animation . Michihiro Tsuchiya ( Major 2nd 2nd Season ) is handling the series composition and Ryou Yamauchi ( Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai ) is designing the characters. Kouji Nakamura ( Eureka Seven AO ) is composing the music.

The Suikoden franchise debuted in 1995 on the PlayStation, drawing inspiration from the classic Chinese novel Shui Hu Zhuan ( Water Margin ). Konami released Gensou Suikoden II ( Suikoden II ) in December 1998, followed by three more games in the main series in July 2002, August 2004, and February 2006 as well as multiple spin-offs.

Shinjirou Hori penned a light novel adaptation under Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko imprint with illustrations by Fumi Ishikawa from December 2000 to September 2001.

title: WIXOSS TCG to End New Production in February 2027
content:
The next expansion pack will serve as a memorial for the game and gratitude towards its fans. Support for the game will continue until October 31, 2027.

English releases for the card game ended in September 2025 with support lasting until that November.

Takara Tomy launched the WIXOSS card game in April 2014. The Selector Infected Wixoss anime series also premiered that month, followed by a second season, Selector Spread Wixoss , in October of that same year.

The Selector Destructed Wixoss anime film then opened in Japan in February 2016. The 12-episode Lostorage incited WIXOSS anime premiered in October 2016, and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired. Wixoss Diva(A)Live , the newest television anime in the franchise , premiered in January 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

Funimation released Selector Infected Wixoss on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in September 2015, and released Selector Spread Wixoss on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in June 2016.

Tomy International launched the card game in English in November 2021.

title: This Webtoon Anime Deserves to Be the Next Solo Leveling
content:
Solo Leveling has only one rival, and it should become the next Solo Leveling when its anime adaptation arrives. Following the immense success of Solo Leveling , many new series emerged, taking inspiration from its foundation. Its success ultimately created a subculture, inspiring a wave of webtoons that showcased similar storytelling and attempted to capture the essence of Solo Leveling . However, not many series were able to achieve the same. Now, following the anime’s success, many webtoons have also received anime adaptations. This year alone has seen several series with a similar structure, with two in particular, Tomb Raider King and Overgeared , coming particularly close to Solo Leveling .

However, while these series are clearly trying to become the next Solo Leveling , especially evident in Tomb Raider King , they have yet to capture the same essence or achieve a comparable level of popularity. This is why a series needs an already popular webtoon fanbase to have a chance of becoming the next Solo Leveling and garnering the same level of popularity. This is precisely why Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint , which was first released in 2018, is the only series that can truly become the next Solo Leveling . It has often been called Solo Leveling ‘s rival, and when its anime adaptation arrives, it needs to live up to that reputation.

The Next Solo Leveling Should Be Its Biggest Rival: Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint

Emerging as a web novel in 2018 from the author duo singNsong, Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint became an immediate success with its unique premise of an all-knowing character surviving in an apocalyptic world. The web novel soon received a Webtoon adaptation in 2020, and since then, the series has only recently wrapped up its first season earlier this year. The success of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint is no joke, as the series already received a live-action adaptation that was released last year , showcasing its chaotic world. Considering that Solo Leveling is also aiming to make its mark in the live-action format, ORV receiving this adaptation highlights how it had already established itself as a successful series.

What makes Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint such a huge series is its premise. The story features a character named Kim Dokja, who loves reading the novel Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse (TWSA), in which he also happens to be the only reader. On the day the final volume is released, after Dokja finishes reading it on a train, the world around him begins to follow the events of the novel. At first, Dokja struggles to comprehend the situation, but soon, as the only person who knows everything about this world, he begins using his knowledge to survive and eventually emerges as a hero to those around him. The only major similarity to Solo Leveling is the RPG system element, in which everyone receives a system to track their progress, while their actions are observed by higher entities.

In this apocalyptic world, where failing to complete a task can result in death, the story challenges the human mind and questions morality. As someone who knows everything that is bound to happen, Kim Dokja uses his knowledge to his advantage while also making moral choices that challenge the idea of a traditional heroic journey. He emerges as a smart and intriguing character, leaving fans constantly wondering what he will do next. The anime adaptation of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint is already in the works, and once it arrives, it has the potential to challenge Solo Leveling ‘s position, all thanks to its premise and a far more intriguing main character.

Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint ‘s Anime Adaptation Is Coming Soon

The anime adaptation of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint was first announced in 2024 during Anime Expo 2024, and since then, there have been very few updates on the project. However, recent leaks suggested that the anime was scheduled to arrive sometime in 2027 . More recent rumors, however, have suggested that its release might be pushed to 2028. While this is not a good sign, the anime’s announcement has not been canceled, giving fans hope for its future. Considering that the webtoon also finished its first season earlier this year, it seems the studio might be planning a larger adaptation of the first season, giving fans a substantial number of episodes rather than just 12.

Given the number of events that occur within a short period and how closely they are interconnected, it would be better for the adaptation to take its time and deliver a larger season that provides a complete narrative. It is the interconnected storytelling and depth of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint that make the series much more intriguing than Solo Leveling and explain why it has been dubbed its rival. This is also why it makes sense for Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint to become the next Solo Leveling when its anime adaptation finally arrives.

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's New Animated Trailer by Masami Ōbari Features Laocorn
content:
SNK began streaming on Thursday an animated trailer for its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring Season Pass 3 DLC character Laocorn, from the Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime film, who also joined the game's roster on the same day. Masami Ōbari ( Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture , The King of Fighters XV , Battle Arena Toshinden ), who directed previous animated trailers for the game, was again the director and creative producer. Studio G-1 Neo also again produced the animation.

Animated Trailer (English)

Animated Trailer (Japanese)

The game debuted in April 2025 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam and the Epic Games Store. The game launched on Nintendo Switch 2 digitally on October 22, and it will get a physical release on January 21.

The game's crossover with Street Fighter includes characters Ken and Chun-Li. Both characters are a part of the game's Season Pass 1. The game launched Andy Bogard as a playable character in June 2025, added Ken as a playable character in August 2025, introduced Joe Higashi as a playable character in October 2025, debuted Chun-Li in November 2025, and launched MR. BIG in December 2025.

Kim Jae Hoon, the first DLC character for the game's Season Pass 2, launched on January 22. Nightmare Geese launched on February 26, and Blue Mary debuted on March 26. Wolfgang Krauser debuted in the game on April 24, coinciding with the game's first anniversary. DLC character Mr. Karate launched on May 27. Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star debuted in the game on June 28.

The game added real-life DJ Salvatore Ganacci , professional soccer player Cristiano Ronaldo, and Hokutomaru. Other returning characters include Terry Bogard, Rock Howard, Tizoc, Hotaru Futaba, Marco Rodrigues, B. Jenet, Kevin Rian, Billy Kane, Mai Shiranui, Kim Dong Hwan, and Gato. The game also includes the new characters Preecha and Vox Reaper.

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Film Opens at #5 in Japan
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , stayed at #1 in its second weekend in Japan, and sold 508,000 tickets to earn 861,165,800 yen (about US$5.40 million) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 2.54 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 4,045,289,100 yen (about US$25.37 million).

The film has also become the highest-earning live-action IMAX film in Japan (counting earnings from IMAX screenings exclusively).

The film ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 699,000 tickets and earned 1,130,171,300 yen (about US$7.11 million) over the November 6-8 weekend.

The film had an irregular opening day in Japan, opening on Tuesday, November 3 (films in Japan usually open on Fridays), which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. The film earned 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan on its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan. The film sold 1.61 million tickets and earned 2,539,531,100 yen (about US$15.98 million) in its first six days.

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō also returned to compose the music. Shirogumi Inc. handled the film's visual effect.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, rose from #5 to #3 in its 17th weekend. The film sold 99,000 tickets and earned 142,817,900 yen (about US$895,700) from Friday to Sunday.

The film has sold a total of 12.98 million tickets, and earned a cumulative total of 18,962,206,300 yen (about US$118 million). The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 12th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

The live-action film adaptation of Yuu Nagira 's Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku (You Are Akin to the Stars) novel dropped from #3 to #4 in its sixth weekend. The film earned 98,168,200 yen (about US$615,600) from Friday to Sunday. The film has sold a total of 1.45 million tickets and earned a cumulative total of 2,117,250,000 yen (about US$13.27 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 234,000 tickets and earned 350,531,400 yen (about US$2.23 million) in its first three days.

The film stars Ryūsei Yokohama ( Detective Conan: Highway no Datenshi 's Kazuaki Ōmae) as Kai Aono and Suzu Hirose (live-action Chihayafuru films' Chihaya, The Boy and The Beast 's Kaede) as Akimi Inoue. Michihito Fujii (live-action Last Samurai Standing ) directed the film off a screenplay by Naoko Adachi (live-action Daytime Shooting Star , Un chocolatier de l'amour perdu ).

The novel's story begins on an island in the Seto Inland Sea. Akimi, who lives on the island, meets Kai, who just moved to the island. Both bond over their misgivings about their own families and life. Akimi's home life is strained by her father constantly cheating, while Kai's mother constantly makes both of them move to be with a new relationship. The two get into a complicated, supporting, and co-dependent relationship over the course of 15 years.

Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, opened in Japan at #5. The film earned 105,658,650 yen (about US$662,600) in its first three days.

The film opened in Japan on November 13. The franchise is also spawning a new game titled Expelled from Paradise -The Stellar Angel- ( Rakuen Tsuihō -The Stellar Angel- ) with an original story that will launch on November 26 for Nintendo Switch and PC via Steam .

While the original announcement of the film had featured the title Rakuen Tsuihō: Libera ted from Paradise , a later announcement listed the title as Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance as well as Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance instead.

The film reunites the main staff of Expelled from Paradise , including director Seiji Mizushima , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , character designer Masatsugu Saitō , and composer NARASAKI . Toei Animation produced the animation.

The live-action film reboot of CAPCOM 's Resident Evil survival horror game franchise dropped from #7 to #9 in its sixth weekend. The film earned 40,183,550 yen (about US$252,000) from Friday to Sunday, and has earned a cumulative total of 2,226,422,550 yen (about US$13.96 million).

The film opened in Japan on October 9 and ranked at #2 in its opening weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets and earned 626,567,150 yen (about US$3.97 million) in its first three days.

The film opened in the United States on September 18. The film ranked at #1 and earned an estimated US$60 million in its opening weekend in the U.S.

The film stars Austin Abrams ( Weapons , Euphoria , Wolfs ) as Bryan. The cast also includes Zach Cherry , Kali Reis , and Paul Walter Hauser ( Richard Jewell , Black Bird , The Fantastic Four: First Steps ).

Zach Cregger ( Barbarian , Weapons ) directed the new film.

The live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga fell from #9 to #10 in its fourth weekend.

The film opened in Japan on October 23. The film sold 141,000 tickets and earned 200,272,200 yen (about US$1.27 million) in its first three days.

Shunsuke Michieda (live-action My Love Mix-Up! TV series, live-action The Kindaichi Case Files series) stars as Kohaku Ichimura, and Seira Anzai (live-action Insomniacs After School film, live-action Trillion Game TV series) stars as Yoi Takiguchi.

Other cast members include Rintarō Mizusawa as Takuto Ohji, Yuna Hoshino as Nobara Tone, Sayu Suzukawa as Kotobuki Hibiya, Takato Ōkura as Sentarō Akane, Tatsumi Asa as Shun Kuwabatake, Yūki Yoda as Yoshiko, and Naohito Fujiki as Seiichi Takiguchi, Yoi's father.

Kentarō Takemura (live-action Trillion Game TV series) directed the film, and Yuichi Tokunaga (live-action Densha Otoko TV series) wrote the script. Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , Aquarion: Myth of Emotions ) composed the music. TBS TV oversaw production at TBS Sparkle , and TOHO is distributing.

Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque left the top 10 in its second weekend.
